findings.message: <audio> has data-start but no id attribute. The renderer requires id to discover media elements, so this audio will be SILENT in renders.
findings.fixHint: Add a unique id attribute: <audio id="my-audio" ...>

findings.message: GSAP tween uses `repeat: -1` (infinite), but the composition declares a finite 18s window. HyperFrames clips deterministic seeking and export to that explicit duration.
findings.fixHint: Keep the explicit finite composition `data-duration`. Use a finite repeat count only when the loop itself must end before the composition does.

findings.message: This HTML composition file has 372 lines. Smaller sub-compositions are easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Split coherent scenes or layers into separate .html files under compositions/, then mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so each file stays small enough to inspect, revise, and validate independently.

findings.message: Track 1 has 4 timed elements in this HTML file. Smaller sub-compositions keep timelines easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Move coherent scene groups into separate .html files under compositions/ and mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so the timeline stays easier to inspect, revise, and validate.

findings.message: Font family used without @font-face declaration: plus jakarta sans. These are not in the auto-resolved font list, so the renderer cannot supply them automatically. Text will fall back to a generic font, producing incorrect typography in the video.
findings.fixHint: Add @font-face { font-family: '...'; src: url('capture/assets/fonts/...woff2'); } for each font family, pointing to the captured .woff2 files. For an OS-bundled system font (e.g. Hiragino Sans, Microsoft YaHei) that has no downloadable file, use src: local('Exact Font Name') instead. The declaration alone satisfies this check without needing a font file.

findings.message: <div id="scene1"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="scene1"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
